caption: The drawing depicts an opulent interior with a floral wallpaper covering the walls in hues of pink, red, yellow, green, and blue. There is a large mirror with a gold ornate frame on the left side, and below it is a pale yellow upholstered settee with a tufted back, alongside another matching settee on the right side of the room. Each settee has intricate wooden detailing and rests on four legs. In the center, there is a gold and glass table with a large, dark blue vase decorated with white and purple floral designs. Two large green potted fern plants are positioned near each settee. At the back of the room, there are two dark wooden double doors with intricate glass or carved panels, and yellow drapes hang on both sides of the doors. A large, detailed carpet with a green, red, and brown floral pattern covers most of the wooden floor. To the right, the staircase with wooden railings winds upward, partially visible; in front of the staircase, there is a blue and gold decorative lamp with an elaborate gold base. Above, two ornate chandeliers with glass shades and gold detailing hang from the ceiling. Near the right settee is a floor lamp with a pink ruffled lampshade, and on the floor in front is a rectangular pink and gold cushion. The composition is filled with detailed patterns and rich colors.
title: Entrance Hall
